thread.title: Toyota’s new 2019 Avalon Rocks with Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s CarPlay

author: Grant Pasek
title: Toyota’s new 2019 Avalon Rocks with Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s CarPlay
text:
January 16, 2018 Toyota’s new 2019 Avalon Rocks with Apple Inc. (AAPL)’s CarPlay 
According to AppleInsider, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s CarPlay platform, is a first for a Toyota car, and it is coming with Toyota’s new 2019 Avalon, as it was announced by the compnay at the 2018 North American International Auto Show. 
Most famously, Toyota (TM) has abstained from adopting either Android Auto or CarPlay in its cars. 
The national manager of Toyota’s advanced technology communications, John Hanson, commented to The New York Times that the company “prefer[red] to use our in-house proprietary platforms for those kinds of functions,” Back in 2015. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s stock on Monday   $176.18   popped up 1.03% to reach at $177.09. Analyst’s mean target price for AAPL is $186.30   1.80. Stock value has moved between $118.06 – 177.09 in last one year. The company confirmed in a comment to MacRumors that CarPlay will show up in additional 2019 cars from Toyota and Lexus that run the company’s Entune 3.0 (for Toyota) and Enform 2.0 (for Lexus) infotainment platforms as well. It has yet to clarify whether or not 2018 models already running those platforms will get support through a software update. 
Even when Toyota switched to another company’s system in 2016, it was to adopt Ford’s SmartDeviceLink app platform, not Apple or Google’s software. Last year at NAIM 2017, Toyota and Ford founded the SmartDeviceLink Consortium, with a focus on extending iOS and Android apps to car dashboards without having to cede control to Apple or Google. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) yearly performance is 48.50% and net profit margin is 21.10%.   7.90%.   -0.06%   49.81% ahead of its 52-week low. About Grant Pasek
